notes: Vandalia Avenue (printed VANDALIA ... AV.) is the whole ~100 ft strip between the north blocks (1, 2, 3) and the south blocks (4, 5, 6) with the C.H.&D. R.R. tracks running down it (Vandalia house numbers on both faces), so its centreline is the middle of that strip, not the label line; no printed width. It runs from Cherry (and on SW across 617) to the Blue Rock / Hamilton junction at the top right, where Vandalia, Blue Rock and Hamilton meet in one open area crossed by the tracks (three centreline crossings recorded). Blue Rock: north face mostly off the top edge, centre taken 30 ft from the south face (60' printed); its faces jog ~33 ft at Turrill (point is the centre of the open crossing, plus two bend points). East of Hamilton the block corner is at y~470, which does not fit a straight 60' Blue Rock; Blue Rock/Hamilton point follows the west side. Apple jogs ~35 px west north of the tracks. Turrill (north part) runs from Blue Rock to Vandalia only; block 4 lies between Vandalia and Hoffner; Turrill resumes south of Hoffner. Cherry is 50' north of Hoffner (west face x~137) and 40' south of it (west face steps to x~195; east face continuous at x~440). McMakin St. here is only 12' wide (measured, no label). Doorman is printed DOORMAN (Dorman on 616 and the key map). Hamilton/Hoffner/Spring Grove plaza at lower right is the same junction as on 616 and modelled the same way (Hoffner ends at Hamilton; Hamilton meets the Spring Grove south-leg centreline at the plaza mouth); Spring Grove is printed 90' at the plaza and 60' further south; Dodsworth and the Spring Grove NE leg are off the east edge. Three unnamed 10' alleys: N-S through block 6 (Vandalia to Hoffner), E-W through block 5 (Apple to Gulow), E-W through block 11 (Turrill to Apple).
